name: calculate_quote
description: Prices a dealer's order. Call this after confirming the items and quantities with the caller. Returns line prices, volume discounts, the one-time total, any monthly subscription total, a quote number, and whether manager approval is required. Never calculate prices yourself.

dealer_id.description: The caller's dealer number, for example D-1042

extra_discount_pct.description: Extra discount percentage the caller asked for, beyond volume discounts. Use 0 if none.

lines.description: Products and quantities on the order

sku.description: DESK-STD, DESK-SIT, CHAIR-ERG, PRINTER-MFP, PAPER-CASE, TONER-SUB, or INSTALL
